jobs.title: Food Safety Auditors - LAOS
jobs.reason: Pure mismatch — food safety auditing in the hospitality industry is unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy/research focus. Hard ineligibility also applies: the role requires specialist food safety certifications (HACCP, ISO22000, BRC, or NEHA) and 5+ years of food industry experience, none of which the candidate has.

jobs.title: Commercial Bid Manager
jobs.reason: This is a commercial bid management role in testing/inspection/certification — unrelated to IR, policy, or intelligence. It also requires a hard minimum of 5+ years in bid management plus financial modelling expertise the candidate lacks, triggering hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Food Safety Auditor - Germany
jobs.reason: This is a food safety auditing role requiring specialist experience in delivering food audits and hospitality environment expertise — entirely unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy background. The candidate lacks the specific auditing qualifications and food industry experience required.

jobs.title: Senior Assessor - Food
jobs.reason: This is a food industry auditing role requiring a bachelor's in food technology, 5+ years in food production, and third-party auditing qualifications (FSSC 22000, BRCGS, HACCP) — none of which the candidate holds. Hard ineligibility on the 5-year experience requirement and specialist food-safety certifications; field is entirely unrelated to IR/policy/intelligence.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.reason: This is a client management / consultative sales role in responsible sourcing and ESG assurance — adjacent to policy only loosely, and primarily commercial account management rather than research. The role hard-requires 7-10 years of experience including 2+ years in CSR/sustainability, which the candidate (MSc in progress, student-assistant background) does not meet. Hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Lead Auditor - IMS
jobs.reason: This is a senior third-party management-systems auditing role (ISO 9001/14001/45001) requiring substantial auditing experience and qualifications the candidate does not hold. Field, skills, and seniority all mismatch entirely with the candidate's IR research profile.

jobs.title: Seafood Auditor - Global
jobs.reason: Field mismatch — this is a seafood certification auditing role (aquaculture, food safety, supply chain compliance) with no relation to the candidate's IR, policy, or intelligence targets. It also requires specialist auditing qualifications and sector experience the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Technical Manager, Seafood
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a seafood/aquaculture technical auditing role requiring a tertiary qualification in marine biology, fisheries, or food science, plus 3+ years industry experience and auditing credentials the candidate does not have. No overlap with the candidate's IR/policy background.

jobs.title: Communications Manager
jobs.reason: While International Affairs journal sits squarely in the candidate's substantive area, this is a communications/marketing role requiring proven experience in multi-channel comms strategy, SEO, and analytics tools — not research. The "Manager" title and "proven experience" framing point to a mid-level comms professional, and the candidate lacks the specific communications-campaign track record the role centres on.

jobs.title: Operations Support Manager
jobs.reason: Although Control Risks is a core target employer in commercial intelligence, this is an operations support management role rather than an analyst/research position, so the substantive field alignment with the candidate's IR/risk research background is weak. The "Manager" title and operations focus also indicate experience requirements and skills (operations management, internal business support) that don't match the candidate's research-oriented profile.

jobs.title: Senior Business Consultant
jobs.reason: Anthesis is a sustainability consultancy and this role sits in Brand & Comms / Client Service — outside the candidate's core IR, policy, intelligence, or OSINT zones. The "Senior" title also implies several years of consulting experience the candidate does not have, triggering a seniority mismatch.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant - Transactions Advisory Due Diligence
jobs.reason: ESG/sustainability due diligence for M&A transactions sits well outside the candidate's core IR/security/policy targets and is closer to commercial sustainability consulting than geopolitical risk. The "Senior Consultant" title and expectations to lead global projects and advise on commercial transactions require professional consulting experience the candidate lacks, and the role assumes ESG/transactions domain knowledge not evidenced in the CV.

jobs.title: Curator: Modern Archives and Manuscripts
jobs.reason: This is a specialist curatorial role focused on 17th–18th century manuscripts and archives, which sits well outside the candidate's IR/policy/intelligence target zones. It requires professional experience with manuscript cataloguing, archival standards, and collection management that the candidate does not have. Additionally, the role cannot sponsor a Skilled Worker visa, which is likely a practical barrier.

jobs.title: Employment Specialist – Connect to Work, Oxfordshire
jobs.reason: Employment support/welfare-to-work casework is unrelated to the candidate's IR, policy research, geopolitical risk, or OSINT targets. The role requires direct employment-coaching and client-facing case management skills the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Account Director | Healthcare Policy, Advocacy & Public Affairs | London
jobs.reason: Account Director is a senior role requiring a proven track record in account management, team leadership, budget management, and new business pitching — none of which the candidate has from their student-assistant background. Healthcare policy/public affairs is policy-adjacent but outside the candidate's core areas, and the seniority gap is decisive.

jobs.title: Account Director, Financial Practice
jobs.reason: Financial communications advisory is well outside the candidate's core IR/policy/risk targets — this is corporate financial PR, not policy or geopolitical analysis. The role requires 3–6 years of financial advisory experience plus specialist knowledge of M&A, IPO processes, disclosure obligations, and financial media handling, none of which the candidate has. Director-level title with team management responsibilities exceeds the candidate's MSc-stage experience.

jobs.title: Edelman UK Internship Programme
jobs.reason: Edelman is a major communications consultancy with a Public Affairs practice that is policy-adjacent, though the rotational programme spans Brand, Health, Tech and Creator Marketing which dilutes the policy fit. Internship seniority is ideal, and the candidate's research, writing and analytical skills transfer cleanly to media monitoring, content development and research tasks.

jobs.title: Major Donor Assistant
jobs.reason: This is a fundraising/donor stewardship role, not a research or policy position — it sits outside the candidate's three target zones despite MSF's humanitarian mission. The role requires fundraising/sales/relationship-management experience the candidate lacks, and the work itself (managing HNW donor portfolios) does not draw on their IR research, analytical, or writing strengths in a meaningful way.

jobs.title: Trusts and Foundations Assistant
jobs.reason: This is a fundraising/relationship management role focused on donor stewardship for Trusts and Foundations, which sits well outside the candidate's target zones of academic/policy research, geopolitical risk, or OSINT/computational research. While MSF is a humanitarian organisation and the entry-level seniority fits, the role is essentially fundraising administration rather than research or analysis, and the candidate lacks specific fundraising/relationship management experience.
